lateral_flank_blob_constellation.centroid_triangulation: High-luminance circular pixel clusters arranged in a semi-regular 2D grid; highest concentration of local maxima is visible in the mid-lateral zone posterior to the pectoral fin base.
lateral_flank_blob_constellation.stripe_intersections: Subtle vertical bands of elevated pixel intensity intersect with high-luminance blobs, forming a discernible grid-like pattern across the mid-flank region.

carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: Single prominent horizontal ridge running along the upper third of the flank, characterized by a sharp transition from high-intensity specular highlights on the superior edge to lower-intensity shadows on the inferior edge.

dorsal_fin_surface_patterning.internal_spot_density: Approximately 4 to 6 distinct high-luminance circular blobs are visible within the silhouette of the first dorsal fin, primarily located near the anterior base and along the trailing edge.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Prominent semi-circular notch or tissue deficit on the posterior trailing edge of the first dorsal fin. Irregular high-luminance linear marks on the dorsal surface of the caudal peduncle.
other_distinctive_markers: The visible pectoral fin displays a higher spatial frequency of small-diameter high-luminance spots compared to the larger blobs on the lateral flank.
